note: High (10,200 ft) USFS campground beside Buffalo Peaks Wilderness on the east side of Weston Pass, a few miles up County Road 22 (CR 5 from US-285 south of Fairplay). Bear country: a bear closure order is in place, store food hard-sided. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov (10165736, Scan & Pay) API/rates: confirmed 14 sites, vault toilets, no potable water, $22 (2026-2028), FCFS; added max 25 ft (stated trailer/RV limit), season mid-May to mid-Oct, booking (Scan & Pay / fee tube, 14 nights). Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: Website: stored https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc is the forest home page. Use the campground's own page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/weston-pass-campground (and recreation.gov https://www.recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/10165736, first-come Scan & Pay listing).

Phone: none stored. South Park Ranger District 719-836-2031 (FS Weston Pass page, Contact Information and Office Contact Information). recreation.gov's '(661) 702-1420' and tbolton@goexplorus.com are the concessionaire's (Explorus). Suggest 719-836-2031.
Length: FS and recreation.gov both state 'a maximum trailer length of 25 feet' and 'The max length for RVs or trailers is 25 feet.' Recorded 25. That is over 23 ft, so EKKO fits, with little margin.

Road: the FS page gives only directions ('From Fairplay, travel south on U.S. Highway 285 for about 5 miles and turn right onto County Road 5. County Road 5 will turn into County Road 22, and Weston Pass Campground will be on your left a few miles down County Road 22.'); recreation.gov adds 'Facility roads are not paved.' Neither page says anything about road surface, RV suitability or 4WD on either side of the pass, so the note no longer claims '2WD-passable' (no agency source) and says nothing about the west side. No PSICC alert or forest order names Weston Pass or CR 22 (the South Park RD 'National Forest Service Road 8 closure' is a different road). Not confirmed open now beyond the absence of any closure; season ended mid-October.

Water wording conflict: the FS page says 'There is no water or trash service' and 'Potable water is not available at this site', then 'A hand pump is available.' recreation.gov says only 'There is no water'. Kept potable_water false; the hand pump, if it exists, is not described as drinkable.

Pin 39.07634,-106.13453 (= FS/recreation.gov facility point) is at the campground entrance where its road crosses the creek meadow from CR 22. recreation.gov's catalog has one placeholder site with no coordinates. Kept.

Waterfront (stored creekside, NOT confirmed - re-audit lead): on NAIP (0.2 m/px) the South Fork South Platte here is a small (1-3 m) meandering channel in a willow meadow ~60-80 m wide. The campground road runs NW along the forest edge on the meadow's SW side, and the sites visible (RV pads off that road) sit in conifers ~50-60 m from the channel across willow scrub; the channel only approaches the forest edge near the entrance crossing. With no per-site coordinates, no site could be placed on the bank; on what is visible the creek is neither at the sites nor clearly in view (creekview at best, possibly not waterfront).
